name: leukoencephalopathy with brain stem and spinal cord involvement-high lactate syndrome
description: This disease is characterized by progressive cerebellar ataxia with pyramidal and spinal cord dysfunction, associated with distinctive MRI anomalies and increased lactate in the abnormal white matter.
